name: skills
title_zh: 向量库调优前先问一句：你的搜索是慢在召回还是慢在重排
tagline_zh: Qdrant 官方技能合集，覆盖调参、监控、迁移、SDK 调用。不给你通用向量知识。
tagline_en: Official Qdrant skill pack: scaling, perf, monitoring, migration, SDKs. No generic vector theory—only steps that.
desc_en: Agent skills for Qdrant vector search: scaling, performance optimization, search quality, monitoring, deployment, model migration, version upgrades, and SDK usage across Python, TypeScript, Rust, Go, .NET, Java
why_zh: 每个技能都绑定 Qdrant 具体版本与 API 行为，不是泛泛而谈的向量数据库教程。
why_en: Each skill pins to a specific Qdrant version and API behavior. Skip three doc hunts per task.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Qdrant 生态，不教 Milvus/Weaviate/ES。需要你已有可访问的 Qdrant 实例或集群。
limit_en: Qdrant-only. No Milvus/Weaviate/ES. Requires a live Qdrant instance or cluster; useless for pure concept learning.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Qdrant tuning skills: fix slow recall or slow rerank first
